Our personalised pop figure word art print is a fun gift for fans of the TV series Friends: a sitcom pop figure in brown and black inspired by Chandler Bing, built from a name and your words.

Your personalised pop figure word art print, made with your words

Fill in two boxes: the name, which sits once prominently in the design, and your word list of 20 to 30 words separated by commas, such as nicknames, hobbies, friends and favourite things. Short words work best. We print exactly what you type, so check the spelling.

Posted the next working day (same day if you order before 12pm) by Royal Mail. A fun personalised gift for a fan's birthday or Christmas.
